title: Service container pulled from Docker Hub without credentials
msg: Service containers are pulled in 'Initialize containers', before any step runs — a docker/login-action step cannot authenticate this pull, so it counts against the anonymous per-IP quota.
fix: Add credentials: {username, password} to this service, or pull it from a mirror registry.

limits.unauthenticated: 100 pulls per 6 hours per IPv4 address or IPv6 /64 subnet
limits.multi_arch: a multi-arch image counts one pull per architecture

title: Job container pulled from Docker Hub without credentials
msg: The job container is pulled before the first step — a docker/login-action step cannot authenticate it, so it counts against the anonymous per-IP quota.
fix: Use the long form container: {image, credentials: {username, password}}, or a mirror registry.

title: uses: docker:// image pulled from Docker Hub at job setup
msg: docker:// action images are pulled while the job is set up, before your login step, so the pull is anonymous.
fix: Replace with a run: docker run step placed after docker/login-action, or reference the image on a mirror registry.

title: docker pull / run / create of a Docker Hub image with no Docker Hub login before it
msg: No docker login (or docker/login-action for Docker Hub) runs earlier in this job, so this pull is anonymous.
fix: Add docker/login-action (no registry: = Docker Hub) with a Docker Hub access token before this step.

title: Login goes to another registry while the job pulls from Docker Hub
msg: This login sets registry: to a non-Docker-Hub host; Docker Hub pulls in the job stay anonymous.
fix: Add a second docker/login-action step without registry: for Docker Hub.

title: Self-hosted runner: anonymous Docker Hub pulls share one NAT IP
msg: Self-hosted runners behind one NAT or proxy share one public IP, so every anonymous Docker Hub pull from the fleet draws on one per-IP quota.
fix: Log every runner in to Docker Hub or put a pull-through cache registry in front of the fleet.

title: FROM pulls a Docker Hub base image
msg: This base image resolves to docker.io; the build pulls it anonymously unless the build host is logged in to Docker Hub.
fix: Make sure the build step logs in to Docker Hub, or point FROM at a mirror registry.

title: Compose service image resolves to Docker Hub
msg: docker compose pull / up fetches this from docker.io with the host's credentials — anonymous on a fresh CI runner.
fix: Run docker login before compose in CI, or use a mirror registry for this image.

title: Kubernetes image from Docker Hub with no imagePullSecrets
msg: Nodes pull this from docker.io anonymously; every node that starts the pod counts against its own IP's quota.
fix: Add imagePullSecrets with a Docker Hub token, or use a pull-through cache registry.

title: GitLab CI image from Docker Hub without DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG or Dependency Proxy
msg: The runner pulls this image before the script runs; with no DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG and no Dependency Proxy prefix the pull is anonymous.
fix: Prefix with ${CI_DEPENDENCY_PROXY_GROUP_IMAGE_PREFIX}/ or set DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG for the runner.
